patches_modified.name: Brave Startup Performance Optimization

patches_modified.name: Clean New Tab Page

patches_modified.name: Locale PAK Slimmer
patches_modified.description: Strips unselected language resource PAKs from assets/locales/.

patches_modified.name: Native Bloat Slimmer

patches_modified.name: Sensor Privacy Guard
patches_modified.description: Neutralizes motion, ambient, and orientation sensor providers to prevent hardware fingerprinting and tracking via Generic Sensor APIs.

patches_modified.name: Skip First Run

patches_modified.name: Suppress In-App Promos & Surveys
